descriptions.notStarted: Your training continues. You must keep progressing until the Black Mage is defeated once and for all. You should ask #b#p1201000##k what to do next.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1201000# says you can only train so much in #m140000000# and suggests you venture to #bVictoria Island#k. She directs you to an ally of hers, #b#p1002104# the Information Dealer#k, in #b#m104000004##k.\r\n\r\nIn order to reach #m104000000#, you must leave #m140000000# by boarding a ship. From town, head to your right and continue past the snow-covered field to arrive at a small port operated by penguins.  Once there, talk to #b#p1200003##k to board the ship.
descriptions.completed: #p1002104# the Information Dealer was once a resident of #m140000000# eagerly awaiting the Hero's revival, but he eventually lost hope and left town. He's a distant cousin of #p1201000#. He must have felt bad about leaving #p1201000# all by herself, because he promised to help #p1002104# anytime she needed it.
